name: flick-goal
description: Flick Goal - one-tap field-goal flick arcade game (no bundler; Capacitor wraps it for Android)

scripts.build:android-debug: node scripts/build-web.mjs --profile android-debug && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-config.mjs --profile android-debug
scripts.build:android-release: node scripts/build-web.mjs --profile android-release && npx cap sync android && node scripts/android-config.mjs --profile android-release
